summary: iter131 — Verified Customer Expo app new Profile and Addresses pages (ports of ProfileEditor + DeleteAccount and AddressBook + AddressForm from web CustomerDashboard). Backend: 8/8 pytest PASS. Frontend: all listed data-testid IDs render, gender/DOB bottom sheets open, delete-account dialog cancel path works, address form CRUD (create → set default → delete) works end-to-end with proper toasts and serviceability lookup.

backend_verified.POST /api/auth/address: 200 · returns full user with new address appended in addresses[]

frontend_verified.Profile page: profile-page + page-title 'My Profile' render. profile-editor card with profile-photo avatar, profile-name, profile-phone (+919000000004), profile-completion% bar all present. All conditional profile fields per /api/auth/config visible: pf-name, pf-email, pf-gender, pf-dob, pf-altmobile, pf-language, pf-comm, pf-gst, pf-company. save-profile button rendered.
frontend_verified.Gender sheet: pf-gender opens pf-gender-sheet bottom sheet; pf-gender-opt-male option present and selectable.
frontend_verified.DOB sheet: pf-dob opens pf-dob-sheet with pf-dob-year-1990 chip present (calendar day cells not verified due to needing year selection first, but sheet + year chip confirm DateField renders).
frontend_verified.Delete account: danger-zone card renders with delete-account-btn. delete-account-dialog opens with both delete-cancel and delete-confirm; cancel closes dialog (confirm NOT clicked per instructions).
frontend_verified.Addresses page: address-book + page-title 'My Addresses' render. address-count shows '1 saved location'. add-address-btn opens address-dialog bottom sheet.
frontend_verified.Address form: gps-detect-btn, gps-required-hint visible; address-map is NOT rendered when lat/lng empty (as spec required). addr-label-home/office chips, addr-line, addr-pincode, addr-city, addr-property-type, addr-wing/floor/flat, addr-landmark, addr-instructions, addr-set-default checkbox, save-address-btn all render.
frontend_verified.Validation: Clicking save-address-btn with empty line/pincode surfaces 'address & pincode' error toast.
frontend_verified.Serviceability: After typing 6-digit pincode 560001, serviceability-status element appears.
frontend_verified.CRUD flow: Created TEST address (line 'TEST 789 UI Street', pincode 560001) → new address-card-<id> rendered, count went 1→2. edit-address-<id> opened Edit sheet. set-default-<id> → default-badge-<id> appeared. delete-address-<id> → card removed and 'Address removed' toast shown.

critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/auth/address returns the full user object (with addresses[] appended) rather than just the created address. Callers that need the new address id must scan addresses[] — Customer app uses a subsequent GET /api/auth/addresses reload which works, but returning the created address directly would be cleaner and save a round-trip.

profile.tsx save() computes 'completion' from photo/name/email/gender/dob but the backend GET /api/auth/me may not echo the 'photo' base64 back reliably; consider re-syncing completion from server state after refresh().

success_rate.frontend: 100% on functional acceptance IDs (profile fields, gender/DOB sheets, delete dialog cancel, address CRUD end-to-end)
